The '''abandoned tram station''' was a [[Tram/Legends|tram]] station located in the [[Old World]], on the planet [[Zakuul]].<ref name="KotFE 10" /> In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|4.1}}</ref> during the [[War against Zakuul]], the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Theron Shan]] rescued [[Kaliyo Djannis]] who was attacked by [[Eternal Empire]] [[skytrooper]]s in the station.<ref name="KotFE 10" />
